_why_this_file_exists: This is the proof that adding a second process is a new JSON file and not new code.
Everything below is measured from dataset B in exactly the same way the 発注管理 definition was.
It is NOT runnable here: the prototype ships one mock screen (発注管理), and this
screen has no mock behind it. `state: stub` is what the engine checks, and it refuses
to run a stub rather than pretending. Pointing `target.base_url` at a 勤怠・休暇申請 mock
and flipping `state` to `active` is the entire change — engine.py is untouched.
Note what differs from 発注管理, because this is the part that would have been
* selector prefix   la   instead of   rt
* the row is opened on td:nth-of-type(4), not td:nth-of-type(3)
* a different column set, a different note template, a different note placeholder
* step-2 variant_rate 0.42 against 0.17, so more cases will fail the enum precheck
and land in the exception queue — which is the correct outcome, not a regression.
